hack.root_cause: ERC-4626-style cToken exchange rate manipulation + rounding error
hack.description: Hundred Finance is a Compound fork that uses hTokens (cTokens) to track lending positions. The protocol had deployed two WBTC hToken markets — one active and one empty (unused by the UI). The empty hWBTC market became the attack surface.
